registration.title: Line-up changes the match before
registration.what: The expected margin moves by a value per line-up change: the number of starters each side changed in its previous match (known days before kickoff), home minus away. A second candidate uses the changes in the match itself (known an hour before).
registration.why: The owner, 2026-10-29: does how many changes a side made the week before help predict its next game? The model sees each side's predicted XI but not how much it has been rotating.
registration.how: experiments/rotation/DESIGN.md: the value chosen on 2023-07 to 2024-06, scored once on 2021-07 to 2023-06 and 2024-07 to 2026-10-11, on the stored projections.
registration.hypothesis: A side's line-up changes in its previous match tell the model something about its next match that its predicted XI does not.
registration.success_criteria: experiments/rotation/run.py: test log loss on covered matches better with its 97.5% interval below zero, holdout better, test Brier no worse, better in 2024/25 and 2025/26, no goal market worse by more than 0.0005.

events.label: A, prior changes: test 2024-07 to 2026-10-11, matches with both sides' previous-match changes known; 0.045 goals per change chosen on 2023/24
events.meaningful: No help shown: worse on test (+0.0011) and on the holdout (+0.0008), better only in 2025/26, 4 of 12 competitions no worse. The model's goal-difference error doesn't move with a side's changes the match before (bands 0-1, 2-3, 4-5 all within 0.03 goals of zero; 6+ is +0.10, 95% -0.03 to +0.25, on 585 side-matches). Covers 16% of matches: those with both XIs recorded.

events.label: B, changes now: test 2024-07 to 2026-10-11, matches with both sides' changes in the match itself known; 0 chosen on 2023/24
events.meaningful: No help shown: validation chose no change (0), so the candidate is the model itself. The model's error doesn't move with a side's changes in the match either (all bands within 0.03 goals of zero on test except 6+, +0.06 with a wide interval).
